plugins.name: presentations

plugins.name: memes

plugins.name: saas-backend

plugins.name: web-ui
plugins.description: Web UI patterns: a shared search/filter bar, a shared sortable List view, and screens in framework-less single-page apps.

plugins.name: data-analytics

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write without sounding like AI: a brand voice system, two editing passes, and the craft of fourteen forms from fiction to technical docs.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Take a change from request to production: isolate and plan it, run the gate, open and merge the PR, deploy and prove it by fetching the live site.

plugins.name: ab-testing
plugins.description: Run product A/B tests end to end: design the arms, assign accounts once at signup, build the results board, then promote the winner and remove the rest.
